hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:b10a4d3a-1831-4634-bb4.title: Step into the Hexa ecosystem
hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:b10a4d3a-1831-4634-bb4.description: JOIN OUR NETWORK OF EXCEPTIONAL TALENT Be part of what's next at Hexa We want to know more about you! But before that, a bit of context about us. About Hexa Hexa started as eFounders in 2011 to rethink company creation: building alongside founders, not from the sidelines. We've built over 50 companies, including Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan, and Yousign, with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, and companies employing more than 2,600 talented people all around the world. Our hands-on model has proven successful. Now a leading multi-stage startup studio, we stay true to our DNA: founder-first and deeply involved, across AI, Future of Work, fintech, climate, defense and cybersecurity. Because when ambitious founders and teams come together, exceptional companies are born. To fulfill this incredible purpose, we're constantly looking for exceptional individuals. Whether you're planning on launching a top tier company or joining one, here's a simple and quick get-to-know-you form that will help us match you with the best opportunities from the Hexa family. Start a Company with us Partner with us for 12 months to build the foundations of a new category-defining company — and 10x your chances of success with our team as your co-founder. Join the Core Team The team that co-builds every startup we launch. You work across multiple ventures in parallel, embedded with founders from day one, across product, design, go-to-market, recruiting, finance, and legal. If you want to be at the heart of company creation, this is it. Join a Hexa venture early Every year, Hexa co-founds around 12 new startups. Joining one in its first months means taking a founding employee role: you build the product, shape the culture, and own a real stake in the outcome, with the full support of Hexa's Core Team behind you. Join a Hexa portfolio company Some of our startups are further along. They're scaling, hiring, and looking for strong profiles to help them grow. If you want the energy of a startup with more structure and traction already in place, this is the path. Your turn! :))

jobgether-jobgether:lever:42538c8b-c7a7-.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:42538c8b-c7a7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in South Africa. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders. A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality

jobgether-jobgether:lever:482eee84-6f8e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA Tester - Brookhaven based in Brazil. Join a fully remote quality assurance team supporting a leading Roblox roleplay experience played by millions of users. You’ll help ensure every update delivers a smooth, reliable, and engaging player experience across mobile, tablet, PC, and console. The role combines hands-on testing with a strong player-first mindset, requiring curiosity, precision, and excellent attention to detail. You’ll work closely with QA, design, and development teams to identify risks before releases reach players. Your ability to reproduce issues and communicate findings clearly will directly influence product quality. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact on a large-scale gaming experience while working in a globally distributed environment. Test the game in both live and QA environments across mobile, tablet, PC, and console, ensuring broad test coverage and identifying issues early. Reproduce, investigate, and document bugs with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, logs, and other relevant supporting materials. Approach testing from the player’s perspective, representing community expectations and identifying issues that could negatively affect the user experience. Collaborate with the QA Lead to develop and execute comprehensive test plans designed to anticipate potential issues ahead of releases. Work closely with other QA testers to communicate testing progress, risks, findings, and results, ensuring effective coverage across assignments. Maintain a methodical approach to repetitive or high-volume testing while meeting deadlines and release requirements. Help protect the quality and consistency of the game by identifying inconsistencies, defects, and details that may not meet expected standards. Requirements Previous experience in a QA, testing, gaming, or other detail-oriented environment is valuable, with professional Roblox game development or QA experience considered a plus. Active experience as a Roblox player and a strong understanding of Roblox gameplay, player behavior, and community expectations. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly and concisely. Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies, defects, or unexpected behavior. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and maintain consistent testing coverage. A focused, patient, and methodical approach to repetitive or high-volume tasks. Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues at different levels and communicate progress, risks, and results clearly. Availability to work full-time, 40+ hours per week. Must be 18 years of age or older. Benefits Competitive compensation, including above-market salary, profit sharing, and stock options. Retirement benefits, including company contributions where applicable based on country and local programs. Medical, dental, and vision coverage, with additional benefits potentially available depending on location. Flexible paid time off, including vacation and applicable federal or bank holidays. Fully remote, work-from-home/anywhere model. In-person team gatherings and virtual company-wide gaming events. Robux allowances and additional gaming-related perks. Professional development support, including reimbursement for courses, materials, and training. Opportunity to collaborate with a global team and contribute to a game experienced by millions of daily players. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b4296150-21c1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. The role combines hands-on troubleshooting with exceptional communication, customer enablement, and continuous improvement of support operations. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c241d5ca-d74f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Cloud Engineer based in Sweden. This is a mid-level cloud engineering role focused on designing, deploying, and optimizing AWS environments for diverse client needs. You’ll work across a variety of cloud engagements, adapting solutions to different business requirements and technical challenges. The role combines hands-on infrastructure engineering with client advisory responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence cloud architecture and implementation. You’ll leverage infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containerization, and automation to build reliable and scalable cloud environments. You’ll also identify infrastructure issues, improve performance and costs, and apply strong security practices throughout project delivery. The environment is dynamic and technology-focused, with opportunities to work across modern AWS services and evolving cloud technologies. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and delivering practical cloud solutions for clients. Deploy, configure, and maintain modular cloud-based systems and infrastructure within AWS environments. Advise clients on the design, architecture, and implementation of modern AWS cloud technologies aligned with their business requirements. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure and application deployment challenges across cloud environments. Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management practices. Implement and maintain CI/CD processes using tools such as GitLab, CircleCI, and GitHub Actions. Configure Kubernetes clusters and support application deployments within containerized environments. Design and maintain secure AWS networking environments, including VPC configurations and related security controls. Optimize cloud operations by identifying opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Ensure data storage and processing solutions meet client requirements, policies, and operational standards. Apply AWS security best practices throughout architecture, deployment, configuration, and ongoing operations. Stay current with emerging AWS services, cloud engineering practices, automation technologies, and industry standards. Collaborate with engineering teams and clients to deliver effective solutions and adapt quickly to changing project requirements. Requirements Demonstrated experience working as a Cloud Engineer, AWS Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or in a closely related infrastructure role. Hands-on experience deploying and configuring AWS cloud resources in production or client environments. Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform and/or CloudFormation . Practical experience building or supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, CircleCI, GitHub Actions , or comparable platforms. Experience configuring Kubernetes clusters and deploying applications in containerized environments. Solid understanding of AWS networking, VPC architecture, and cloud security principles. Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and application deployment issues using structured analytical and problem-solving approaches. Experience identifying opportunities for AWS performance, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure automation and configuration management practices. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and provide practical recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Strong adaptability and willingness to work across varied client environments and business requirements. An AWS Associate- or Professional-level certification is preferred.
